'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[2024 missile strikes in Yemen]]
***The [[United States Central Command]] says another round of U.S. strikes has destroyed 14 [[anti-ship missile]]s in [[Yemen]] that were being prepared to launch at merchant vessels and [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] ships in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-conducts-another-round-strikes-against-houthi-targets-yemen-2024-01-18/ (Reuters)]
**[[Operation Prosperity Guardian]]
***The [[United States]] redesignates the Yemen-based [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] as a [[terrorism|terrorist]] organization in response to continuing [[Red Sea crisis|attacks in the Red Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-relists-houthis-terrorists-response-red-sea-attacks-2024-01-17/ (Reuters)] [https://archive.ph/Lt4WF#selection-1561.3-1561.63 (Archive)]
*[[2024 Iran–Pakistan border skirmishes]]
**[[2024 Iranian missile strikes in Pakistan]]
***[[Pakistan]] recalls its ambassador to [[Iran]] in response to the missile attack on its territory that killed two civilians. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/01/17/iran-pakistan-baluchistan-strike-tensions-israel-hamas/78d05e04-b504-11ee-b285-0853d4d1b92f_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2024 Ecuadorian conflict]]
**[[Prosecutor|Public prosecutor]] {{ill|César Suárez (Ecuadorian prosecutor)|es|César Suárez|lt=César Suárez}}, who was investigating the takeover of the [[TC Televisión]] newsroom by armed men, is killed in [[Guayaquil]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/1/18/ecuador-prosecutor-investigating-gang-attack-on-tv-studio-shot-dead (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Suphan Buri fireworks explosion]]
**At least 19 people are killed and three others are missing in an explosion at a [[firework]]s factory in [[Suphan Buri]], [[Thailand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-suphan-buri-fireworks-factory-explosion-43e9c2265f11dcadfb2276a3cfa6ddd5 (AP)]
*Three people are killed and 77 others are injured in an explosion caused by explosives stored for use in [[illegal mining]] operations at several buildings in [[Ibadan]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-ibadan-explosion-mining-18e2d0ee449c020f9c0e116bc04edad4 (AP)]
*Three people are killed when a [[power line]] falls on a car during a major [[winter storm]] in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], [[Oregon]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/us-winter-weather-snow-freezing-low-temperatures-e4b2f623ff13112ae241b05f3584503e (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Bashkortostan protests]]
**Thousands of people protest the trial of [[Bashkirs|Bashkir]] activist [[Fail Alsynov]] in [[Baymak]], [[Bashkortostan]], [[Russia]]. Clashes with police are reported. [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-bashkortostan-alsynov-rally-support/32775278.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Lèse-majesté in Thailand]]
**[[Thai people|Thai]] activist [[Arnon Nampa]] is sentenced to four years in prison for posting a [[Lèse-majesté|royal insult]] on [[social media]] in 2021. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/thai-lawyer-who-called-monarchy-reform-sentenced-more-jail-time-4053891 (CNA)]
*Three people are killed and five others injured during a [[mass shooting]] against a group of men outdoors in [[Morvant]], [[Trinidad and Tobago]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trinidad-shooting-morvant-eastern-caribbean-719ee5b82329c35b8dd863663af54331 (AP)]
*Former [[President of Guatemala|Guatemalan President]] [[Alejandro Giammattei]] is barred from entering the U.S. after the [[United States Department of State|State Department]] accuses him of "significant corruption". [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/guatemalan-ex-president-giammattei-barred-entry-into-us-state-dept-2024-01-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[United Kingdom|UK]] [[Home Secretary]] [[James Cleverly]] announces a ban on [[Hizb ut-Tahrir]], an [[Islamic fundamentalism|Islamic fundamentalist]] movement, for its support of [[Hamas]] and "violently antisemitic rhetoric". [https://www.algemeiner.com/2024/01/15/british-home-secretary-announces-ban-against-antisemitic-hizb-ut-tahrir-organization/ (''The Algemeiner'')]
